CustomField.formula: IF( VALUE(LEFT(TEXT(Start_Time__c), 2)) >= 12, TEXT(VALUE(LEFT(TEXT(Start_Time__c), 2)) - 12) & ":" & MID(TEXT(Start_Time__c), 4, 2) & " PM", IF( VALUE(LEFT(TEXT(Start_Time__c), 2)) = 0, "12:" & MID(TEXT(Start_Time__c), 4, 2) & " AM", LEFT(TEXT(Start_Time__c), 5) & " AM" ) )
CustomField.label: Start Time Text
